scope: Static module review for the cheap-demo type-1 sprite 19 program with the bonus-room exit repair. The recipe pins the donor record, the protected block and one reviewed code patch.

code_patches.role: Clear Y before the 1-up scan. The caller at 18FB01 does TYA/BEQ to decide whether to write the bonus-game end timer 14AB. The scan sets Y=1 on a match and leaves it unchanged on no match, so a stale non-zero Y skips the timer write and the bonus room never starts its exit. This restores the demo6 and demo7 behaviour.

open_dependencies: entry qualification against the cheap-demo donor

unapplied_rom_patches.role: Install the sprite 19 record and point init/main into the AF module view
